section_rules.results_main_effect: tier 必须等于设计允许层；已验证主效应用 tentative（may/might）= under-claim flag（claim-calibration「勿过度回缩」）
section_rules.methods_m7_model_spec: 按设计族词汇表；OLS/FE 只可 association 或（DiD 且检验已报告的）effect-of 预告
section_rules.methods_m8_identification: we estimate the effect of 合法当且仅当对应诊断在 Results 已报告（草稿内可检索到 identification_markers）
section_rules.theory_hypothesis: 假设句豁免（hypothesis 不是 claim）：方向性陈述合法；豁免以 hypothesis_markers 命中为据
section_rules.discussion_mechanism: 机制外推须 tentative 档；裸确定性句外推 = flag（causal-hedging 试探性表达条款）

flag_types.OVERCLAIM: 动词档位高于设计允许（含条件不满足时使用条件档）
flag_types.UNDERCLAIM: Results 已验证主效应用 tentative 弱化（稀释贡献）
flag_types.CONDITION_MISSING: 条件档使用但草稿内检索不到对应 identification_markers

prohibitions: no pass/fail gate (must NOT wire into _shared/pass-contract.md)
no auto-writeback to corpus or feedback-registry
n<5 reference cell -> report 'insufficient reference coverage' only
deferred_to_v2: eligible-unit rationale coverage (because/as/since/given per eligible slot)

reference_modes.house_style: rhetoric-moves 批句档（Gulati/Westphal 系 anchor 集；语义锚定原 21 篇，批跑后键名以 key_equivalences 为准）
reference_modes.field_norm: 124 句档全库仅作观察性参考（diagnostic-only）；不构成规范性基准。规范性使用前须完成 section×design 分层覆盖率审计（每 cell n>=5）

changelog: v1.2.3 (2026-09-20): Recall probe round 1 (56 probes/112 docs) adjudication + casing fix family: STAT_HARD/UNDERCLAIM precondition now case-insensitive (Table/Column capitalized forms previously escaped  table\s*\d); STAT_HARD += standard deviation(s) (magnitude reporting); ECON_DIAGNOSTIC += mis-specif (7-paper corpus precedent incl. armed_roots itself). Probe results: recall 41/42=0.976 (1 accepted cross-sentence miss), PASS specificity 4/4, adjudicated-NAV consistency 10/10, 0 contamination. Floors: Results 8 flags/5381 = 1.49/1000 (frozen baseline exactly restored), full 41-paper 2.1/1000, synth 4/2/4.

v1.2.2 (2026-09-20): First real-draft pass (共同所有权×产品召回 project, author's own unpolished drafts) adjudicated 2 guard-coverage FPs: SUPPRESS_PRODUCE_OBJECT += 'a similar result(s)/comparable results/similar estimates/nearly identical' (bootstrap-procedural produces); causes noun guard += '(?<!root )' space variant (root cause data field, was hyphen-only). Manual counter-check of all causal-verb sentences in the draft confirmed 0-flag verdict is genuine (author's Results claim calibration already floor-consistent), not under-sensitivity. Floors unchanged: Results 1.5/1000, full 2.1/1000, synth 4/2/4.

v1.2.1 (2026-09-20): Results-section specialized floor calibration (91 papers, 5381 results sentences) 18.9->1.5 flags/1000 in 3 adjudicated rounds (R7-R9). Fixes: hypothesis_markers spelling bug (hypotheses? never matched singular; now hypothes(?:is|es) + markdown-link tolerance); cond_ok case-insensitive (This indicates that); STAT_ATTACHED_DIR/STAT_ATTACHED window [^.]->[^;] (decimal points killed unit matching); nonsig += non[- ]significant; PROCEDURAL_LED_TO += parameter/estimat; PRODUCE_GOODS += classifications/categories/types; NOUN_SUBJECT discourse openers + stacked modifiers; SLOPE_CHANGE reversed-order (verb ... effect of); NEW guards: MODEL_SIM extensions, DESCRIPTIVE_STATS, RIVAL_EXPL, GIVEN_PREMISE, ROBUST_TO, CONSTRUCT_DEF, EXAMINE_WHETHER, WE_REASON, MECH_SEARCH, HEDGE_WITH_STATS, appendix cross-refs, infinitive to-context, italic/math parity, positional quote context, STAT_SUBJ bracket-link tolerance (Table A17) + panels?, THEORY_MODE += we argue/posit, HEDGE_BEFORE += plausibly/arguably, modal_guard extended to CONDITION_MISSING. Residual 8 flags classified X/S/L/P; 41-paper negative control stable at 2.2/1000.

v1.2.0 (2026-09-20): Step 2.5 floor-test adjudicated revisions — 41-paper negative control 21.8->2.9 flags/1000 in 5 rounds; noun-usage guards (causes/drives/increases/prove), T_MECHANISM narrowed (bare-noun âµ removed; works-by requires process/mechanism/channel/effect subject), lit-review + not-consistent-with-view + non-significance + methods-procedural + stat-attached-causation suppressions, RESULT_MARKERS verb-form extensions, discussion reporting-frame exemption, hypothesis predict(ed/ing). All anchored to specific exemplar sentences (see metric-contract.md changelog).
